segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so for Northlake, can you sanity check the renewal quote before I send it to deal desk? They’re at 42 seats today, adding 8 more for the field team.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Sure. Is this the facilities analytics package plus onboarding hours, or just the subscription?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Subscription only. They used 18 of the 25 onboarding hours already, and Kara said they’ll hold the rest for the October rollout.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. I’m looking at the CRM now. Their current agreement ends August 31, and I don’t see any notes that we’ve talked to them about continuing yet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, I’ll call Kara this afternoon. Pricing sheet has them at $38,400 annual, and with the 8 seats it goes to $45,600 if we keep the same tier.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That matches. Just make sure billing keeps the invoice split the same, 70% to corporate and 30% to the Denver site, because they kicked back the last one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ll put that in the order notes. They also asked for net 45 again, no change to the standard terms otherwise.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Fine by me. If they want the September 16 go-live for the new users, we should get the signed order by the 9th so provisioning isn’t a scramble.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Agreed. I’ll send the draft after deal desk approves, and I’ll flag the seat add separately so support can prep the workspace.
